contract_plain_english: For the homogeneous one-dimensional constant coefficient system q_t + A q_x = 0, assume A has real eigenvalues and a complete set of m linearly independent eigenvectors. The source states that every state vector decomposes uniquely in that chosen basis and that this yields component waves, each propagating at the signed speed given by its corresponding eigenvalue. The acoustic matrix illustrates the claim with speeds −c and +c, where c = √(K/ρ). These claims are anchored in raw PDF page 23, printed page 1, equation (1.1); raw PDF page 24, printed page 2, equation (1.6) and its characteristic-wave discussion; and raw PDF page 25, printed page 3, first paragraph. The general decomposition is referred forward to Chapter 3, and the supplied passage does not prescribe a precise solution regularity class.
